Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/memory_permission_scopes.py

src/agent_runtime/memory_permission_scopes.py

Python · Tier A

Implement live Controller permission authority over immutable RAM views and atomic cross-domain writes. The shared hierarchy resolves prompt, conversation and global policies while dispatch refreshes restrictions, validates exact consent and rejects stopped/deleted tasks. Grants, revisions and bounded audit records publish with run state; checkpoints preserve those domains separately from this runtime API.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
audit 19 Append a modes-only permission audit record in the selected RAM domain, using its transaction sequence and pruning entries older than the latest thousand positions. Publication is owned by the surrounding atomic policy update.
MemoryPermissionAuthority 41 Implement the shared permission interface over one Controller RAM hub. Settings, conversation and run views join a single immutable revision or writer transaction, allowing grants and run-state updates to publish atomically without runtime SQL.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.connect 55 Reject attempted SQL connection use explicitly; RAM authority callers must use record views and atomic hub transactions.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.initialize_global 60 Atomically insert the inherited global permission record if absent. An existing record is preserved by the absent-only write, including after checkpoint restoration.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.read_in 79 Read nullable policy and revision from settings, chats or native prompt records through the same transaction. Thaw immutable values for callers, preserve inherited absence and raise for an unknown conversation.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.write_in 107 Normalize and revision-check one policy scope, update its RAM record and append the audit in the same writer transaction. Return the new revision without independently publishing or checkpointing it.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.set 150 Serialize a scope edit with the shared authorization lock and atomic native writer. Reject prompt edits for missing, ended or tombstoned runs before updating policy and its audit record.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.resolve 195 Resolve all scopes through one immutable native-domain view and its cross-domain transaction, without opening SQL or issuing network/model requests.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.resolve_in 201 Reuse shared scope precedence against the supplied RAM view and mark the restored saved policies as already authoritative. A complete checkpoint does not require blanket permission revalidation.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.dispatch_authority 212 At admission reject stopped/deleted tasks and exact user-denied operation IDs, then refresh live permission policy and validate any saved one-shot confirmation. Update context with its current revision and exact-confirmation result; return a PolicyBlock for an enforced denial lacking exact approval. Other execution checks remain with their respective owners.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.consume_exact 258 Atomically revalidate and remove a saved one-shot approval for the exact run, capability, arguments and operation identity. Return false if invalid or the task was stopped/deleted, preventing reuse after successful consumption.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.execution_context 276 Overlay a retained run's current guard overrides and revision onto a copied context, giving run-owned values precedence over caller context. Return the original context unchanged if no retained state exists.
MemoryPermissionAuthority.grant 294 Hold the shared authorization lock while applying the inherited grant checks inside one RAM writer transaction; policy, audit and updated pending-run state publish together.
